summary: Iteration 2 verified the K Bridge bug-fix batch. Backend regression (4 pytest cases) 100% pass. Frontend verified: language toggle works and persists via localStorage; KO/EN switching flips nav + content; hero wordmark 'K BRIDGE PARTNERS' visible with new KO headline and sub-headline; no '00' eyebrow numerals sitewide; Home renders 회사의 관점 with exact copy and About K Bridge stat placeholders ([수십]/[Decades], [X], [X], [8]); About page has 4 about-stat cards and no standalone 01/02/03/04 large numerals; Services renders 5 equal-width pillar cards (Market Research, Entity Setup, Commercial Real Estate, Franchise Development, Store Opening); Process is a 5-item Accordion with the first item open by default; FAQ has 6 items with all 6 exact KO questions; Locations renders 8 city cards (dc, va, mia, nyc, nj, dal, atl, lv) each with an image; Contact form submits and shows KO toast '문의가 접수되었습니다'.

issues: service-pillar cards have equal widths (437px) but slightly uneven heights (611px vs 575px) between first 3 and last 2 cards. Spec says 'equal-weight' — visually close but not perfectly uniform.

A few Korean fragments still appear in EN mode Home body text (e.g. '신뢰','실전','경험','전문성','현지','네트워크','시장 조사','법인 설립','상업용 부동산','프랜차이즈','매장 오픈'). These likely leak from pillar/short-label sections that were not localized. Bulk of page (hero, nav, CTAs, stats) is properly EN.

action_items: (Minor) Normalize Services 5-pillar card heights so all five are visually the same size (add min-height or ensure equal body length).
(Minor) Localize the remaining Korean short-labels leaking into EN Home page (pillar teaser tags and small callout labels).
critical_code_review_comments: i18n implementation: content stored inline per page is manageable now but will grow; consider extracting to /src/i18n/{lang}.json for maintainability if more languages are added.
Accordion accessibility looks good (data-state=open on process-step-0 by default). Ensure aria-expanded is also set by shadcn primitives (verified visually).
Locations city cards each render an tag — verify lazy-loading and alt text for the 8 skyline images (not inspected in depth).
seed_data_creation: One TEST_ contact submission created via /api/contact during regression.
context_for_next_testing_agent: iteration_1 covered baseline API + insights CRUD + contact submit. iteration_2 focused on bilingual toggle, hero updates, section revamps (Home 회사의 관점, About stats, Process accordion, FAQ 6 items, Locations 8 cities). Backend endpoints untouched from iteration_1; regression trimmed to 4 core endpoints. lang-toggle button data-testid works; use localStorage.setItem('kb-lang','en'|'ko') for deterministic switching.
rca of the issue: N/A — bug fix iteration validated successfully. All primary acceptance criteria met.
